note: Conceptual/architecture lesson on person accounts vs. the default business-account-and-Contact model. No screenshots per this course's policy: taught through prose, tables, and a written scenario, never UI click-paths. Verified directly against official Salesforce documentation: the IsPersonAccount mechanism, the automatically created and uniquely-bound 'person contact,' the inability to independently create/delete/record-type that contact, field-level-security inheritance from the Contact field, supported editions, and Salesforce Help's own framing of business-to-person conversion as having no easy path. The historical 'must be enabled via Salesforce Support' claim was not asserted as current fact, since current enablement process (self-service in Setup vs. support-ticket) could not be confirmed on an official page during this pass -- the lesson instead focuses on the decision's broad, largely one-directional downstream impact, which is documented.
